en.headline: Animals Asia therapy dog programme booked out until February 2027
en.dek: The Dr Dog and Professor Paws visits, run by one staff member and 65 volunteers, are finalists in the teamwork category of the Spirit of Hong Kong Awards.
body: A Hong Kong therapy-dog programme operated by Animals Asia is fully booked until February 2027, as demand from schools, hospitals and elderly homes continues to exceed available slots.

The Dr Dog and Professor Paws programmes rely on 65 volunteers who bring their own dogs, cover much of the transport cost and return regularly to venues across the city. One staff member supports the operation.

The volunteer team has been named a finalist in the teamwork category of this year’s Spirit of Hong Kong Awards, co-organised by Sino Group and the South China Morning Post. Karina O’Carroll, Animals Asia’s animal welfare education manager, said none of the programmes would be possible without the volunteers.

zh.headline: 亞洲動物基金治療犬計劃預約至2027年2月已滿
zh.dek: 由一名職員及65名義工組成的Dr Dog及Professor Paws探訪計劃，獲提名競逐香港精神獎團隊合作組別。
body: 亞洲動物基金營運的治療犬計劃預約已排至2027年2月，學校、醫院及安老院舍的需求持續超出可提供的探訪時段。
Dr Dog及Professor Paws計劃依賴65名義工攜同自己的狗隻參與，義工承擔大部分交通開支，並定期返回全市不同場地。計劃由一名職員支援運作。
義工團隊獲提名競逐本年度由信和集團與南華早報合辦的香港精神獎團隊合作組別。亞洲動物基金動物福利教育經理Karina O’Carroll表示，沒有義工便沒有這些計劃。
